title: Cimmino 2013 · Tactile distance discrimination
citation: Cimmino et al. (2013). Plasticity of body representations after surgical arm elongation in an achondroplasic patient. Restorative Neurology and Neuroscience, 31(3), 287–298.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.context: Companion outcome in the surgical arm-elongation case study.
published_method.apparatus: Four in-line miniature solenoids on a malleable mount. Each stimulus delivers two simultaneous contacts using the MSTC3 system and custom LabVIEW control.
published_method.sequence: Stimulate the right humerus first and the neck 250 ms later. Record the spoken two-choice response by manual entry and give no feedback.
published_method.scoring: Fit the reported psychometric curve. Extract the 50% point and the signed difference between the 75% and 25% locations.
published_method.stimulus_levels: Three spatial levels. Adjacent contact spacing is individual two-point threshold plus 5 mm, matched for arm and neck.
published_method.response: Which of the two sites felt the greater separation between its contacts?
